title: Announcement Regarding Receipt of the Third-Party Committee's Investigation Report (Final Report) and Our Company's Response
excerpt: The completed investigation identified widespread improper accounting and provisional historical effects.
summary: The unchanged final investigation identifies unrecorded inventory losses, impairment avoidance, improperly capitalized labor, reversed provisions, grants misclassified as revenue and inadequate bad-debt allowances. It quantifies cumulative negative effects through fiscal Q1 2025 of JPY 166.4 billion on operating profit and JPY 160.7 billion on period profit before derivative adjustments.
